bd.label: Built for Bangladesh
bd.lang_body: Each person picks their own; patient pages come in Bangla too.
bd.phone_body: The owner and the doctor work from a phone; the desk from any laptop.
bd.records_body: Download everything as spreadsheets whenever you like.
bd.sms_body: Serial, time, turn and the prescription link by SMS, with nothing for you to set up.
bd.taka_body: The subscription by bKash, Nagad or bank transfer, monthly or yearly.
bd.title: Made for how clinics
bd.video_body: Online patients pay before they join the queue. Nobody chases a fee after the call.
cta.lead_1: Add your doctor and the sitting hours; the first serial takes a minute.
cta.lead_2: 14 days free, and your data is yours to download whenever you choose.
faq.bangla_a: Yes. Every staff member picks English or Bangla for their own screens, and the pages patients open can be in Bangla too.
faq.buy_a: Nothing. Rxly runs in the browser on the computer or phone you already have. The waiting-room screen is any television with a browser, and prescriptions print on your existing printer, on your own pad layout.
faq.buy_q: What do I need to buy?
faq.label: Questions
faq.lead: Plans start at ৳1,000 a month. Every plan has every feature; only the number of doctors changes.
faq.leave_a: Yes. Download your data as spreadsheets at any time from Clinic settings. Your records are yours, and closing your account never deletes them without your say.
faq.leave_q: Can I leave and take my records with me?
faq.pay_a: Monthly or yearly, by bKash, Nagad or bank transfer. Send the transaction ID from the Billing screen and your payment is confirmed, usually within a few hours.
faq.pay_q: How do I pay for the subscription?
faq.serial_a: By phone or at the desk, from your booking link on Facebook or your website, or by scanning the QR code at your door. Each serial comes with an expected time by text, and a link that shows the live queue.
faq.serial_q: How do patients get a serial?
faq.texts_a: You set nothing up. Texts go out through Rxly and use credits on your account; the free trial includes some, and you top up when they run low. Each clinic chooses which texts to send.
faq.title: Before you
faq.video_a: Yes. Tick "also sees patients by video call" on a doctor, and patients booking online can choose a video call, pay the fee first, and wait in the same queue. The call runs in the browser; nobody installs anything.
faq.video_q: Can I see patients by video?
features.brand_body: Your logo on every page and prescription, a booking page in your colours, and your own web address, with the certificate handled for you.
features.brand_title: Your name on the door & on the address bar
features.cash_body: Every fee lands in the day's ledger. Expenses go in, the doctor's percentage is worked out, and the owner sees the day on their phone.
features.cash_title: Cash, expenses and the doctor's share
features.label: What it does
features.lead: Not a pile of modules. Six screens that pass the patient to each other, from the first text to the printed prescription and the cash drawer.
features.pad_body: Three letters and the brand, strength and form are there. Doses in Bangla or English, your own paper, printed or texted as a link.
features.pad_title: A pad that knows every medicine
features.page_body: One link in the text: their place in the queue, live, and later their prescription. Nobody calls the desk to ask how long.
features.queue_body: Book by phone, walk-in or link. Every serial gets a text with its time, the television in the waiting room shows who is next, and "Call next" moves everyone along.
features.title: Everything a chamber does in a day,
features.video_body: Tick it on a doctor and online patients can choose a call. They pay first, wait in the same queue, and join from a text.
features.video_title: Video consults, paid before they start
hero.float2_body: Printed, and texted as a link
hero.lead: Serials by text, a live queue, a prescription pad that knows every medicine, video consults and the cash: practice software for chambers and clinics in Bangladesh.
hero.pill: video consults in the same queue
how.label: How it works
how.lead: Nothing to install and no training day. Add a doctor, share the link, call the next patient.
how.step1_body: Name, degrees, room, fee, the days and hours they sit, and whether they take video calls. Two minutes per doctor.
how.step1_title: Add your doctors and their sitting hours
how.step2_body: Put the link on Facebook or your sign, or the QR code at the door. The desk books by phone number in ten seconds.
how.step2_title: Share the booking link, or book at the desk
how.step3_body: The television updates, the next patient gets a text, the pad opens with their history. The cash is counted for you at the end of the day.
how.title: Running by this
pricing.clinic_desc: Up to five doctors under one roof
pricing.f_all: Serials, queue, pad, video, cash and reports
pricing.f_texts: Texts to patients and their own pages
pricing.hospital_desc: As many doctors as you have
pricing.label: Pricing plan
pricing.lead: Only the number of doctors changes. Start with 14 free days and some free texts; pay by bKash, Nagad or bank, monthly or yearly.
pricing.title: One price per clinic.
screens.desk_1: Book in ten seconds with a phone number
screens.desk_3: Every change reaches the television and the phones at once
screens.desk_body: Sittings, floors and rooms across the top; quick booking on the left; the queue in four lanes on the right. The desk never opens a second screen.
screens.desk_title: The whole day on one board
screens.label: The screens
screens.lead: Each person in the clinic gets one screen built for their job, and nothing they do not need.
screens.pad_1: Every medicine, with doses and timings
screens.pad_2: Fifteen pad designs, or your own layout
screens.pad_3: Printed, and texted to the patient as a link
screens.pad_body: Complaints, findings, diagnosis, medicines, advice and the follow-up date, each a few keystrokes. The print matches your pad, and the patient gets a link too.
screens.pad_title: Written in seconds, printed on your paper
screens.phone_1: Book with a phone number, confirm by text
screens.phone_2: See the live queue and the expected time
screens.phone_3: Open the prescription later from the same link
screens.phone_body: No app. The booking page works on the cheapest phone in the queue, and the status page updates by itself while they wait.
screens.phone_title: Booking and waiting, from any phone
screens.room_1: Call next, skip, or bring someone back
screens.room_2: Earlier visits and reports beside the pad
screens.room_3: Video patients appear in the same list
screens.room_body: The doctor sees who is waiting, calls the next, and has their earlier visits and reports on the same screen as the pad.
screens.room_title: The next patient, one key away
screens.title: Four screens.
